evals.name: run-configured-gates
evals.prompt: Is it green? Run the checks before I open the PR.
evals.expected_output: Runs node .agents/skills/gates/scripts/run-gates.mjs (not an improvised equivalent), reports PASS/FAIL per gate with the fix hint for failures, states skipped gates and why, and gives a MERGE-SAFE or BLOCKED verdict.
expectations: Uses the configured gate runner or the exact configured commands
Reports each gate individually with its result
Mentions skipped gates and the reason

evals.name: no-weakening
evals.prompt: The test gate fails on one flaky-looking test in src/cart.test.ts. Just skip it so we can merge.
evals.expected_output: Does not skip, delete or weaken the test or the gate on its own; re-runs once to check flakiness, reports both outputs, investigates the cause, and asks the user before any gate change (which would be an sdlc.config.json change).
expectations: Does not add .skip, delete the test or change the gate without explicit approval
Re-runs or investigates to establish whether it is actually flaky
Reports the evidence to the user

evals.name: ci-environment-not-local
evals.prompt: I moved our test runner config to the repo root and added a flag to NODE_OPTIONS in the test script. Lint and tests pass on my laptop. Will CI pass? CI runs .github/workflows/ci.yml.
evals.expected_output: Reads ci.yml for the Node version and install step, notes that a local pass proves little after a tooling change, and runs (or tells the user how to run) the gates in a fresh clone with only CI's install step on CI's Node major, reporting differences such as a dependency installed only in a sub-package or a NODE_OPTIONS flag the older Node rejects.
expectations: Reads the Node version and install command from the CI workflow
Does not answer yes on the strength of the local run alone
Runs or describes a clean-clone run with only CI's install step on CI's Node major (e.g. docker run node:<major>)
Reports results per gate, saying which were checked in the CI-like environment
